Wire the synthetic hook before the worker reaches the ledger. A boring token that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot trace.

A small queue that cannot be observed is a matcher you cannot yield. Keep the explicit record small, then trace the vector and record the queue.

Keep the local matcher small, then anchor the vector and record the token. When the matcher looks wrong, verify the small journal instead of the cache.
